LESSON: HISTORIC BUILT ENVIRONMENTS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.5: Historic Built Environments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Historic Built Environments. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we conserve the historic built environments?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the importance of the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa
3. demonstrate ways of conserving historic built environments in Eastern Africa

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa on a map
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa on a map. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe the importance of the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the importance of the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. demonstrate ways of conserving historic built environments in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate ways of conserving historic built environments in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Historic Built Environments using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Historic Built Environments in the examples.
2. Explain Historic Built Environments to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Historic Built Environments.
4. Show that you can: identify the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa on a map

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Historic Built Environments using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Historic Built Environments important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the importance of the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa,
2. Digital literacy: Learners use digital/print resources to identify the historic built environments in Eastern Africa.
3. Self-efficacy: Learners confidently compose and recite poems on the importance of historic built environments in Eastern Africa. 10 Pertinent and contemporary issues (PCIs:
4. Assertiveness: Learners practise assertiveness as they collect artefacts and create a cultural corner in school.
5. Human rights and responsibilities: Learners enhance cohesiveness as they visit a nearby historic built environment to learn about the past and write a report. Values:

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the importance of the main historic built environments in Eastern Africa
3. demonstrate ways of conserving historic built environments in Eastern Africa

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
